text: {"hypotheses":[{"statement":"Beverage revenue is high primarily because it is concentrated in a small number of top-selling products, not spread evenly across the menu","priorConfidence":0.55,"target":"beverage_revenue_by_product","action":"breakdown","expectation":"A small subset (e.g. top 2-3) of products account for a disproportionately large share (>50%) of drink_revenue, showing a long-tail/concentrated distribution"},{"statement":"Beverage revenue is driven by a concentrated group of high-spending repeat customers rather than broad-based demand","priorConfidence":0.45,"target":"top_beverage_customers","action":"lookup_block","expectation":"A small number of customers in top_beverage_customers contribute a disproportionate share of total drink revenue, indicating customer concentration rather than broad purchasing"},{"statement":"One customer_type segment (e.g. returning customers) disproportionately drives beverage revenue compared to others","priorConfidence":0.5,"target":"customers.customer_type","action":"breakdown","expectation":"order_item.drink_revenue broken down by customers.customer_type shows one segment contributing a clearly outsized share (not roughly proportional to its order count)"},{"statement":"High beverage revenue reflects sustained month-over-month growth trend rather than a one-time spike","priorConfidence":0.4,"target":"order_item.revenue_growth_mom","action":"compare_time","expectation":"order_item.revenue_growth_mom for drink items shows consistent positive growth across multiple recent periods rather than a single anomalous jump"},{"statement":"Beverage revenue is high mainly due to high order volume (many drink orders) rather than high per-order value","priorConfidence":0.4,"target":"orders.drink_orders","action":"lookup_metric","expectation":"orders.drink_orders count is high and tracks closely with drink_revenue growth, while average revenue per drink order stays flat, indicating volume rather than price is the driver"}]}
